en.headline: Hong Kong actors Anson Kong and Angela Yuen win at Golden Horse Awards
en.dek: Mirror member Anson Kong took best supporting actor for We're Nothing at All, while Angela Yuen won best actress; We Are Born Good claimed best narrative feature.
body: Hong Kong performers received several major awards at the 63rd Golden Horse Awards ceremony held in Taipei on Sunday. Mirror member Anson Kong Ip-sang won best supporting actor for his role in the film We're Nothing at All.

In his acceptance speech, Kong thanked his parents, who were in the audience, and his fans who had supported him from the early stages of his career. He recalled training in South Korea 12 years earlier without debuting, then working as a concert backup dancer in Hong Kong before progressing to the podium.

Angela Yuen Lai-lam won best actress for her performance in Afterpiece, according to multiple reports. The Hong Kong film We Are Born Good took the best narrative feature award, and its writers received the best original screenplay award.
The ceremony was hosted by Hong Kong actor Will Or. Hong Kong films and talent featured prominently among the winners at the awards, which honour achievements in Chinese-language cinema.

zh.headline: 香港演員江⸹生及袁澧林奪金馬獎 善男信女獲最佳劇情片
zh.dek: Mirror成員江⸹生憑《我們不是什麼》奪最佳男配角，袁澧林奪最佳女主角；《善男信女》奪最佳劇情片。
body: 香港演員在周日於台北舉行的第63屆金馬獎頒獎典禮上奪得多個重要獎項。Mirror成員江⸹生憑《我們不是什麼》奪得最佳男配角。
江⸹生在領獎時感謝在場的父母及從早期已支持他的粉絲。他回顧十12年前前往韓國接受訓練但未能出道，之後在香港擔任演唱會後備舞蹈員，逐步走上領獎台。
報道指，袁澧林憑《第四幕》奪得最佳女主角。香港電影《善男信女》奪得最佳劇情片，其編劇亦奪得最佳原著劇本。
頒獎典禮由香港演員柯煒林主持。香港電影及演員在表揚中文電影成就的金馬獎上表現突出。
